game_title: Nested While Dungeon – Bat Hollow Rush
game_concept: A speed quiz set in Shadow Cave – Bat Hollow, a hollow of roosting bats: the cave miner must handle glow-eyed lurkers while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Nested While Dungeon: Run an inner loop for each room inside an outer loop for each floor.
theme: Shadow Cave – Bat Hollow: a hollow of roosting bats
core_gameplay_loop: In Bat Hollow, repeat each round: Run an inner loop for each room inside an outer loop for each floor. Each round, a new lantern oil challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the dungeon_clear value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 180 points of lantern oil by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 180, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 3 (intro tier): Nested While Dungeon
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Nested While Dungeon' (Week 4 slot 15), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Bat Hollow'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Shadow Cave
region.mood: echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how dungeon_clear changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against glow-eyed lurkers in Bat Hollow.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 180 within 36 seconds.
